kept.description: The first item per "site" that no earlier round of the loop kept or dropped, in branch-key order and then list order, each with the key of its branch.

branch.description: The key of the branch that reported the item.

dropped.description: Every entry that the join did not keep, in fold order, each with the reason.

key.description: The key of the entry, or null when the item states none.

branch.description: The key of the branch that reported the item.

reason.description: Why the join dropped the entry.

failed.description: The keys of the branches that failed or did not settle, ordered by key. They reported no entries.

total.description: How many branches the frozen manifest admitted.

completed.description: How many branches completed every stage.

failed.description: How many branches failed a stage.

items.description: One item per branch, ordered by key.

key.description: The branch identity: the item's unique key.

handoff.description: The handoff of the branch's last stage, or null when the branch failed.

step_id.description: The attempt that wrote the handoff.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the handoff content.
